notes: A scorer_entry is candidate eligibility, not a Picked decision or an input to the current single-test scorer.
Only evaluable observations with reads greater than zero are considered.
Different seq_id values from one specimen are technical test support, not independent clinical confirmation.
The within-test rank is provisional because source files retain a filtered organism universe.
Neither raw reads nor RPM are compared or summed across tests.
Unmapped organisms with selected positive tests go to taxonomy/clinical review, not directly to scorer entry.
Physician answers and the old selected-DNA baseline do not affect routing.
